title: Understanding Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm used to minimize a function by iteratively moving towards the steepest descent direction. It is commonly used in machine learning to find the optimal parameters for a model.

title: Convergence of Gradient Descent
text: Gradient descent can converge to a local minimum, but this depends on several factors such as the learning rate, the nature of the function, and the starting point. It does not guarantee convergence to a global minimum.

title: Role of Learning Rate
text: The learning rate is a crucial hyperparameter in gradient descent. If it's too large, the algorithm may overshoot the minimum. If it's too small, the convergence can be very slow.

title: Analyzing the Statement
text: Consider the statement: 'With an infinite number of updates and a fixed learning rate, gradient descent will always converge to a local minimum.' Is this statement true or false?
